boom_fly_family_preflight.status: Analysis only; existing legacy controllers are not certified.
boom_fly_family_preflight.health_blocker: Seven normal-family tuples have baseHP8 AND stageHP3; Tainted25.6 has20/0. Do not apply8*3.2 as constant full HP. Preserved analysis.py documents stage plateau/formula; define explicit DeathWard floor-to-source-stage mapping before changing HP.
boom_fly_family_preflight.documented_stage_formula: baseHP + stageHP * (min(stage,4) + .8*clamp(stage-5,0,5)); source stage5 multiplier remains4.
legacy_gaps: Initial facing uses eight directions, including cardinals; source family requires diagonal flight.
Generic bounce reflects only when total movement is underhalf requested, so one blocked diagonal axis may slide without reflecting; test both axes independently.
Normal/Drowned death uses generic .7s radius2.8 MonsterBomb, currently80 enemy damage. Source-specific blast timing/damage must be established or explicitly adapted.

Bone Fly currently uses generic aimedShot at any bearing and default three-shot death ring. Source requires cardinal alignment for live shots, bone projectiles, and one death bone aligned to nearest cardinal bearing.
Sick death is one radius3 gas patch for4seconds plus six ordinary bullets, not eight persistent clouds and green shots; live gas trail already exists but unverified.
Tainted death lacks documented brief cross glow and faithful delayed cross-room explosions. Keep Ascent-only source identity out of ordinary floor pools.
Dragon cardinal/diagonal fire lines use generic ten*1.5unit patches and2.5s duration; verify extent/collision and preserve subtypeX identity.
Drowned offspring uses an explicit .5 local probability and landing clearance, but source-native probability and exact offspring positioning remain unknown.

Skatole suppresses contact and slows everyvariant; Beelzebub friendship must suppress explosions against player as well as body contact. Current generic companion system must not be assumed to provide these semantics.
